g.text: Badge-powered only, like the maker's original: the board is too small for the CR2032 clip without covering the maker's handwritten message (see README).

g.desc: Badge-powered only, like the maker's original: the board is too small for the CR2032 clip without covering the maker's handwritten message (see README).

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected.

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected.

g.text: 1.3 k (shared part, was an unspecified 'R' or a solder bridge on the original) gives about 0.45 mA through a white LED from 3.3 V.

g.desc: 1.3 k (shared part, was an unspecified 'R' or a solder bridge on the original) gives about 0.45 mA through a white LED from 3.3 V.

g.text: D1 is the LED the maker meant to be bodged across his two VCC / GND pads: a reverse-mount LED behind the bare-board word ITALY.

g.desc: D1 is the LED the maker meant to be bodged across his two VCC / GND pads: a reverse-mount LED behind the bare-board word ITALY.
